Title: Public preview: HTTPS proxy configuration support

Body.Content:
AKS now supports specifying HTTPS proxy configuration when creating AKS clusters and node pools. This facilitates integration with HTTPS proxies that require the node to be configured to have internet connectivity when it boots.

This feature is currently available in public preview.

Learn more.
